decks.name: Spellcaster's Command (SDSC)
decks.manual:
Spellcaster spell-counter control built on the Endymion engine. You bank Spell Counters every time you cast, then cash them in for a 2700 boss and repeatable removal.

## The engine (do this first)
- **Magical Citadel of Endymion** (Field Spell) is the heart: every Spell you *resolve* banks 1 Spell Counter on it, it soaks counters off any counter-card that dies, and it can pay counter-costs for your other cards. Open on it (fetch with **Terraforming**) and just start casting.
- **Win line:** once Citadel holds 6 counters, Special Summon **Endymion, the Master Magician** (2700) by removing all 6 — on summon add a Spell back from GY, and every turn after, discard 1 Spell to **destroy ANY 1 card** on the field. That recurring pop is your control loop; feed it with Spells you've already used.
- **Counter accelerants (stack these):** **Spell Power Grasp** places a counter AND fetches the next copy (chains its own draw of gas); **Apprentice Magician** drops a counter on summon; **Breaker** / **Defender** each place 1 on Normal Summon; **Pitch-Black Power Stone** banks 3 and ferries them one-per-turn onto Citadel. **Magical Exemplar** banks 2 per Spell and dumps them to revive a Spellcaster from hand/GY (re-summon a popped Endymion or Breaker).

## Payoffs that spend counters
- **Breaker the Magical Warrior** — summon, then pop a Spell/Trap for free (1600, briefly 1900).
- **Blast Magician** — remove counters to snipe a monster (counters x700 ATK cap).
- **Dark Red Enchanter** — enters with 2 counters, +300 ATK each, and rips a random card from their hand.
- **Mythical Beast Cerberus** — grows +500 per counter (swings huge, but dumps its own counters after battle).

## Spellcaster tricks
- **Magical Dimension** is the glue: control any Spellcaster, tribute a monster, Special Summon a Spellcaster from hand AND destroy a monster — tribute a spent **Apprentice Magician** / **Old Vindictive Magician** to drop **Endymion** and blow something up at instant speed.
- **Defender, the Magical Knight** shields your Spellcasters from destruction (pay 1 counter each). **Old Vindictive Magician** flips to pop a monster. **Summoner Monk** discards a Spell to swarm a Level 4. **Magician's Circle** searches a Spellcaster on any attack. **Magicians Unite** pumps one Spellcaster to 3000 for a finisher.
- **Field Barrier** locks Citadel down — it can't be destroyed and the opponent can't set their own Field Spell.

## Control shell
- Board wipes / removal: **Fissure**, **Swords of Revealing Light**, **Magic Cylinder**, **Enemy Controller**, **Book of Moon**.
- Tempo & reuse: **Giant Trunade** (bounce your own backrow to re-cast for more counters), **Twister**.
- Equips for a beater: **Mage Power**, **Malevolent Nuzzler**, **Mist Body** (untargetable-by-destruction wall).
- **Royal Magical Library** turns your Spell spam into draws (3 counters -> draw). **Magical Blast** burns 200 per Spellcaster and recurs itself.

## Weaknesses
- ⚠ Slow: you need to survive long enough to bank 6 counters — fast aggro can race you before Endymion lands.
- ⚠ Field-Spell dependent: if Citadel is destroyed before **Field Barrier** protects it (Mystical Space Typhoon, an opposing Field Spell, etc.), the engine sputters.
- ⚠ **Tower of Babel** is anti-synergy with your own gameplan — its 4th Spell Counter blasts *the player who cast that Spell*, i.e. YOU, the spell-spammer. Many pilots cut it; play around it or leave it in the box.
- ⚠ Endymion is one fat target — Bottomless / banish / bounce removes your payoff and the counters spent to summon it.

decks.name: Machine Re-Volt (SD10)
decks.manual:
Machine beatdown + Gadget grind. Signature engine FIRST: the Gadgets loop forever - Green Gadget searches Red, Red searches Yellow, Yellow searches Green. Normal Summon one every turn to draw-plus-one in monsters, never run out of 1200-1400 bodies, and keep tribute fodder on tap. Land all three and Stronghold the Moving Fortress flips up as a 3000-ATK wall/attacker.
Bosses that ignore their backrow: Ancient Gear Golem (3000, piercing, opponent can't activate Spells/Traps while it attacks) and Ancient Gear Gadjiltron Dragon (3000, same Spell/Trap lock). Tribute a Gadget to Normal Summon the Dragon to bolt on a mode - Green = piercing, Red = +400 burn on damage, Yellow = +600 burn on kill. Ancient Gear Soldier / Beast carry the same attack-through-traps lock at lower cost; Ancient Gear Factory and Ancient Gear Castle (counters cut the Tributes, +300/+ ATK) cheat the big ones out.
Finisher - Limiter Removal: double the ATK of every Machine you control the turn you swing (Golem/Dragon 3000 -> 6000, plus doubled Gadgets) for a frequent one-turn kill. They self-destruct in the End Phase, so fire it as the closer, not to trade.
Swarm/burn line: Machine Duplication on a 500-or-less-ATK Machine SS's 2 more copies from Deck - stack Ancient Gear Cannon (Tribute each for 500 damage + Battle-Phase Trap lock) or feed Cannon Soldier tribute shots for 500 apiece. Ultimate Offering buys extra Normal Summons to chain more Gadgets/tributes.
Recursion & disruption: Roll Out! re-equips Heavy Mech Support Platform (+500/+500 and eats one destruction) from the GY onto a boss; Pot of Avarice refuels; Sakuretsu Armor, Enemy Controller, Micro Ray, Covering Fire, Rare Metalmorph, plus MST / Heavy Storm keep the lane clear.
Weaknesses: no Extra Deck; Ancient Gear Golem and Beast cannot be Special Summoned and are slow/tribute-heavy; the whole plan leans on the Normal Summon, so summon-negation or a well-timed removal stalls it; Gadgets have flimsy DEF; a whiffed Limiter Removal wipes your own board.
⚠ Card interactions above are read straight from cards.cdb text (sourced); the play-priority ordering is my own synthesis, not a cited competitive primer.
